settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAccountConfirmBody: This is permanent. Your decks, cards, study history and reading progress are erased from the server, and the books stored on this phone are removed. It can't be undone.

intro.heading: What is Aogimi?
intro.body: Aogimi is a Japanese reading and vocabulary companion. Open an EPUB or PDF, look up any word in the built-in dictionary, save the ones you want to remember as cards, and study them as stars in your sky.
intro.tabs: The bar at the bottom has four tabs: Home, Reader, Dictionary and Sky. Your profile opens from the picture at the top of Home, and Settings is inside your profile.

reading.heading: Reading a book
reading.library: Your books are in the Reader tab. Tap Add Book to import an EPUB or PDF, then tap a cover to open it. The … on a cover lets you rename the book, delete it or sync it.
reading.lookup: To look up a word, press and hold it, dragging to extend the selection if you need to. When you let go, the button at the bottom of the page becomes three actions: Add card, Dictionary and Copy.
reading.dock: At any other time, tap that button for the table of contents, the reader settings and the dictionary. PDFs and image-only books such as manga have no text to select, so open the dictionary from there and type the word. The back button at the top left returns to your library.

dictionary.heading: Dictionary
dictionary.body: The dictionary is built into the app and works offline. Search in Japanese, romaji or English from the Dictionary tab or from Home, or tap Dictionary on a selection in the reader. Results are grouped into words, kanji and names. An entry shows its meanings and, where there are any, its pitch accent, the kanji it uses and an example sentence; Add to deck saves it as a card.
dictionary.sources: Word entries come from JMdict, kanji from KANJIDIC2, names from JMnedict, and example sentences and pitch accents from the Kanjium project. Settings › Credits lists them in full.

sky.heading: Decks and your sky
sky.body: There’s no separate decks page: your decks live in the Sky tab. Each deck is a constellation and each card a star. When you save a card — Add card in the reader, or Add to deck in the dictionary — you choose its deck, or make a new one, right there.
sky.using: Tap a constellation to fly into its deck, and tap a star to see its card. Press and hold a constellation to edit the deck, see its stats or delete it. List shows every card in a deck, and the … at the top of the sky makes a new deck. The Sky needs you to be signed in.

study.heading: Studying
study.body: Continue Studying in the Sky, or Start Review on Home, gives you the cards that are due across all your decks; Study deck does the same for one deck. Reveal each card, then grade how well you remembered it — Again, Hard, Good or Easy — and Aogimi schedules its next review from that.
study.due: Only due cards are offered, because answering a card before it’s due doesn’t change its schedule. As you study, a card moves from New through Met and Learned to Mastered. To choose what a card shows while you study, open Settings › Study display.

account.heading: Your account
account.body: Without an account, your books and decks stay on this device. New sign-ups are closed for now; if you already have an account, sign in from your profile.
account.delete: Sign out and Delete account are at the bottom of Settings. Deleting your account permanently erases your decks, cards, study history and reading progress from the server, and removes the books stored on this phone.

sync.heading: How sync works
sync.body: When you’re signed in, your reading positions, decks and cards are saved to your account. Each device keeps its own copy and syncs with your account when it’s online. Book files stay on the device you imported them on: on another device, import the same file and you pick up where you left off.
sync.legend: The badge in the corner of each book’s cover shows where that book stands:
